bible_band_guide.steps_intro: Your phone must be awake and unlocked before it can read the band. Once you find the right spot, the whole process takes only a few seconds.
bible_band_guide.step_one_copy: Turn on your phone’s screen and unlock it. Most phones will not scan NFC tags from the lock screen.
bible_band_guide.step_two_copy: Use the very top edge of an iPhone or the upper-middle back of most Android phones. Exact placement varies by model.
bible_band_guide.step_three_copy: Place the phone directly against the Bible Band and keep it still while your phone recognizes the NFC chip.
bible_band_guide.step_four_copy: When the website notification appears, tap it to open your fresh daily Scripture experience.
bible_band_guide.placement_intro: The NFC reader sits in a different place on each type of phone. Start with these positions and keep the band touching the phone.
bible_band_guide.iphone_copy: Touch the very top edge of your iPhone to the Bible Band. Hold it there for 2–5 seconds until the notification appears.
bible_band_guide.android_copy: Touch the upper-middle area on the back of your phone to the band. Some models read closer to the center.
bible_band_guide.still_searching_copy: Keep the band touching your phone and slowly slide the top or back across it. Pause for a moment at each position.
bible_band_guide.trouble_intro: Most connection problems can be fixed in less than a minute. Work through these steps in order and try the band again after each one.
bible_band_guide.remove_case_copy: Thick, metal, magnetic, battery, and wallet-style cases can block the NFC signal.
bible_band_guide.move_slowly_copy: Slide the phone across the band slowly until you find the exact reader location for your model.
bible_band_guide.hold_still_copy: Keep the phone touching the band for a full 2–5 seconds. A quick tap may not register.
bible_band_guide.unlock_copy: Wake the screen and unlock your phone before scanning the Bible Band.
bible_band_guide.nfc_on_copy: NFC is usually automatic on iPhone. On Android, make sure NFC is enabled in Settings or Quick Settings.
bible_band_guide.try_phone_copy: A second compatible phone can help confirm whether the issue is reader placement or the band itself.
bible_band_guide.compatibility_iphone: iPhone XS and newer can scan in the background. Earlier NFC-capable iPhones may require the NFC Tag Reader from Control Center.
bible_band_guide.compatibility_android: Most modern Android phones with NFC are compatible. NFC may need to be turned on in your phone’s settings.
bible_band_guide.compatibility_internet: Wi-Fi or cellular data is needed to load the daily page after your phone reads the band.

church_pack.custom_copy: Your church website, a custom landing page, or a ministry hub—we can help. Contact us for custom work, tax-exempt orders, payment by church check, or delivery to multiple addresses.
church_pack.answer1: Mix any sizes and colors. Your total Bible Band quantity qualifies for the best available tier automatically at checkout. No code or invoice request is needed. Ministry pricing does not combine with other product or order discounts.
church_pack.answer2: In-stock orders typically arrive in 5–10 business days. Quantities beyond available stock may be preordered where offered; those orders are expected to ship in 3–4 weeks. Orders ship together. Contact us before ordering for a firm event deadline.
church_pack.faq3: Can our bands open our own church website?
church_pack.answer3: Yes. Contact us before ordering so we can quote the setup and timing for your church website or custom experience. Standard packs open the daily Bible Band experience.
church_pack.faq4: Do people need an app or account?
